newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - FEB 21.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - FEB 21.

text.p: These are the main headlines on Hungary's Kossuth Radio midday news. Reuters cannot vouch for their accuracy:
- Farmers are determined to hold their protest blockade from Monday and will not hold further talks with the goverment, said one of the organising committee.
- There is still no agreement within the Interest Coordiation Council on a new wage round.
- An agreement has been signed on easing the voluntary return of illegal migrants from Hungary.
- Budapest police are confident they will get further information on last night's shooting as the victim is recovering from his injuries
- Prime Minister Gyula Horn and Budapest mayor Gabor Demsky are to give further information on yesterday's government decision to go ahead with construction of the south Buda metro.
